select t.*,
tf.id as "tf_id", tfs.id as "tf_resourcesId", tfs.file_name as "tf_fileName", tfs.extension as "tf_extension", tfs.size as "tf_size", tfs.content_type as "tf_contentType", tf.expiration_date as "tf_expirationDate", tf.description as "tf_description", tf.type as "tf_type", tf.status as "tf_status" from ( select ti.id as "id", ti.unit as "unit", ti.license_plate as "licensePlate", ti.in_service_date as "inServiceDate", ti.year as "year", ti.axles as "axles", ti.length as "length", ti.height as "height", ti.vin as "vin", ti.description as "description", ti.status as "status",
tmk.id as "modelMakerId", tmk.name as "modelMakerName",
tt.id as "typeId", tt.name as "typeName",
ot.id as "ownershipTypeId", ot.name as "ownershipTypeName",
pt.id as "purchaseTypeId", pt.name as "purchaseTypeName",
dr.id as "driverId", dr.first_name || ' ' || dr.last_name as "driverName",
com.id as "companyId", com.name as "companyName",
u.id as "createdById", u.name as "createdByName",
ti.created as "created" from trailers ti left join trailer_model_makers tmk on tmk.id = ti.model_maker_id left join trailer_types tt on tt.id = ti.type_id left join ownership_types ot on ot.id = ti.ownership_type_id left join purchase_types pt on pt.id = ti.purchase_type_id left join drivers dr on dr.id = ti.driver_id left join companies com on com.id = ti.company_id left join users u on u.id = ti.created_by_id where 1=1
and ti.company_id||'' = #{companyId}
and (ti.vin like '%'||#{vinOrUnit}||'%' or ti.unit like '%'||#{vinOrUnit}||'%')
) t left join trailer_files tf on tf.trailer_id = t.id and tf.status = 'ACTIVE' left join resources tfs on tfs.id = tf.resource_id
